proposal.name: Preserve Python lists in component receipts

plan.name: Preserve Python lists in component receipts
plan.summary: Complete step 2 of parent #794 by making sampled and explored Python module observations retain their full state in component receipts: encode each From and To value with the existing module-value conversion and conformance encoder, so empty and nested lists become ordered TLA+ sequences, records keep their fields, and scalar types, exact integers, duplicates and list order survive. Keep the map-of-TLA-value-strings component schema and raw execution observations intact, preserve non-module and attempted-step argument encoding, replay filtering and all conformance qualifications, and retain the streaming TLC recording path. Return state conversion errors instead of storing empty values, identifying the target, check, invocation, run, step, before/after side and field without committing partial component evidence. Acceptance tests compare component values with the recording and generated TLC inputs, carry both modes through JSON and safely rendered Markdown, and require stable round-trip fingerprints that change when component list contents or order change. Update SPEC.md with a citation to [#837's ratified plan](.invariant/plans/issue-837.json) and docs/python.md to describe the shared recording/receipt value semantics, diagnostics and evidence preservation; the README's linked overview remains accurate, and this plan records the repair to D-0170, D-0175, D-0199 and D-0333 without a new one-way-door decision.

tests.name: TestPythonModuleSampledComponentReceipts837
tests.says: Sampled module states, including empty, repeated, reordered and nested lists and exact large integers, agree with the TLC recording in component JSON and safe Markdown, retain raw evidence and scalar types, and bind component fingerprints without changing qualifications.

tests.name: TestPythonModuleExploredComponentReceipts837
tests.says: Explored module states preserve the same values through component receipts and fingerprints, retain attempted-step argument encoding, omit replay rows only from component observations, and keep transition, state and attempt qualifications independent.

tests.name: TestPythonModuleComponentStateErrors837
tests.says: Invalid module and non-module state values return errors identifying the invocation, observation side and field, preserve raw execution evidence and prior component attribution, and never become empty component values.
